name: Nike Cross Regionals Midwest
where: Terre Haute, IN · LaVern Gibson Championship Course
headline: Nike Cross Regionals Midwest
summary: Final: Natasza Dudek won the girls race in 16:39.4 and led Purple Track Club to the team title, 141 to Barrington’s 152, with both teams advancing to Nike Cross Nationals. Jack McGovern of Rockhurst won the boys race in 14:32.4.
